text: Can you pull together every site on Marrow Agrisupply you can find across #central-team? List each with where it comes from. Need it before the customer call.
reply_text:
I've sent Pree the list in our DM. I only read #central-team, after checking she's a member, and found two Marrow Agrisupply sites there for sure, plus one that's likely:

1. Eastbank. Hollis brought it up on 2026-06-09 at 10:46 AM. Ticket PD-4821 has Eastbank's receiving-door import attached, but the import labels the doors E1/E2 while their booking sheet uses 01/02. That has to be fixed before anyone reimports, or it will create duplicates.
2. Pine Crossing. Pree brought it up on 2026-06-09 at 10:48 AM. The appointment screen only shows the afternoon shift, so a driver who arrived at 7:10 was logged on a sticky note. Hollis said he would check the shift template.
3. Wichita store, likely but not confirmed. On 2025-07-02 at 9:21 AM Pree mentioned a check-in with "the Wichita store dispatcher" right after Tobias said her Zoom was hosting the Marrow office hours link. The message never names Marrow, so I asked her to confirm.

I also told her two things in that same 2025 thread aren't Marrow: the Tulsa hub belongs to Tansley Parcel, and Door 6 / ticket #88412 belongs to Tansleigh Packaging.

One gap: Pree mentioned three rows marked "waiting" on Marrow's rollout tracker, but those stores aren't named anywhere in the channel, so I couldn't list them.
